seoTitle: How to Connect FedEx to Shopify with MultiParcels
metaDescription: Integrate your FedEx account with Shopify using the MultiParcels app to enable shipping rates, labels, and easier order fulfillment.
intro: Adding FedEx shipping through the MultiParcels app lets you offer professional delivery options without leaving your Shopify admin. This guide walks through installing MultiParcels, connecting your FedEx account, and configuring shipping rates and labels.

steps.heading: Install the MultiParcels app
steps.body: Search for MultiParcels in the Shopify App Store and install it on your store.

steps.heading: Connect your FedEx account
steps.body: Use the app's setup flow to link your existing FedEx account credentials.

steps.heading: Set up shipping rates
steps.body: Configure the FedEx shipping rates and services you want to offer customers at checkout.

steps.heading: Generate shipping labels
steps.body: Use MultiParcels to create FedEx shipping labels directly for your orders once they come in.

steps.heading: Manage order fulfillment
steps.body: Track and fulfill FedEx-shipped orders from within the app for a streamlined process.

faq.question: Do I need an existing FedEx account?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need an active FedEx business account before connecting it through MultiParcels.

faq.question: Is MultiParcels free to use?
faq.answer: MultiParcels typically offers a free plan with limited features and paid tiers for higher shipping volume, so check current pricing in the app listing.

faq.question: Can I use multiple carriers alongside FedEx in MultiParcels?
faq.answer: Yes, MultiParcels generally supports connecting multiple carriers, letting you compare and choose rates across FedEx and others.

faq.question: Will shipping labels print automatically for new orders?
faq.answer: Label generation is usually manual or rule-based depending on your app configuration, rather than fully automatic by default.
